contact_name.value: BenchmarkEA’s laboratory director has a Ph.D. in organic chemistry

services.value: BenchmarkEA provides environmental sampling and analytical services, including testing for organics, metals, inorganics, physical properties, and microbiology. It also offers environmental analytical and field sampling across surface water, storm water, groundwater, and sediment/soil, with reporting options including hard copy and electronic ADaPT, STORET, and spreadsheet formats.
